title: West Berkshire Council: Development of generative AI tools
summary: West Berkshire reports faster, more consistently formatted job adverts from its GPT tool, with low stated setup and running costs.
account: West Berkshire used GPT-based tools to generate job advertisements and explored internal and public-information assistants. Managers report less drafting time and more consistent formatting. The source reports roughly £300 in setup staff time and £2 in monthly running costs. Recycling and policy assistants were planned, and their benefits had not been established.
purpose: Reduce work drafting recruitment material and explore customized assistants for council information.
system: Custom job-advert generator using OpenAI GPT models and the ChatGPT API; other assistant prototypes
developer: West Berkshire Council using OpenAI models
